info.title: Postbase API
info.description: Schedule and manage social posts on X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon and YouTube. Authenticate with an API key from Postbase → Developers, sent as `Authorization: Bearer pb_live_…`.

get.description: The workspace this key acts for.

post.description: Save a draft, or schedule a post or thread. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retry can't post twice.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a request with the same key to get the first post back instead of a new one.

body.description: The post text, for a single post.

thread.description: Several posts to publish as a thread, in order. Takes precedence over body.

channel_ids.description: Channels to publish to, from GET /channels.

channel_bodies.description: Text for particular channels instead of body, keyed by channel id. Each is a single post.

scheduled_at.description: When to publish: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (2026-10-01T09:00:00+01:00). Omit or null to save a draft.

schedule_in_minutes.description: Publish this many minutes from now, on the server's clock. Instead of scheduled_at.

media_ids.description: Files from GET /media to attach, in order.

media_urls.description: Public https links to images or a video, attached after media_ids. Each is downloaded into the media library (up to 10 per request, 200 MB each).

200.description: A repeat of an earlier request (same idempotency key)

get.description: The post and each channel's status, live URL, error and latest metrics.

patch.description: Edit or reschedule a draft or scheduled post. Only the fields you send change; scheduled_at null turns it into a draft.

still_sending.description: Channels already mid-send, which will finish

get.description: Published posts in a date range with each channel's latest metrics, plus totals for the whole range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC). Up to 366 days.

post.description: Register an https endpoint. The signing secret is returned in this response only.

secret.description: whsec_… Store it: it isn't shown again.

parameters.name: Postbase-Signature
parameters.description: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${raw body}` with the endpoint's secret>

200.description: Return any 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried with backoff (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h).
